script: o=$(mktemp); kind(){ line=; read -r line < "$o"; case $line in "["*) echo full;; "") echo none;; *) echo pid;; esac; }; set -m; /bin/sleep 60 & p=$!; kill -STOP "$p"; /bin/sh -c 'while [ -e "/proc/$1/stat" ]; do read a b s rest < "/proc/$1/stat"; [ "$s" = T ] && break; done' sh "$p"; wait %1 2>/dev/null; echo w=$?; jobs >/dev/null; kill -CONT "$p"; /bin/sh -c 'while [ -e "/proc/$1/stat" ]; do read a b s rest < "/proc/$1/stat"; [ "$s" != T ] && break; done' sh "$p"; jobs -n > "$o"; kind; exec 2>/dev/null; kill -KILL "$p"; wait "$p"; rm -f "$o"
